name: us3-created-count-refused
description: 015, US3 (contract §4.2/§5, data-model.md §5/§6, research R4): injecting a 400 fault with a field-validation errors body on the create — the corpus's first use of `faults` — proves counts.created reports what Jira actually confirmed. The parent's create is refused before any story is attempted (parent-first ordering), so the apply outcome is empty and counts.created is zero, alongside the fail-closed exit code; no other Jira read is collaterally faulted by the project-keyed fault (T003's finding: this fixture's reconcile issues no project-keyed GET at all).
